sorries.obstruction: R1: J⁺(Σ) ∩ J⁻(p) compact in a GH flat spacetime with Cauchy surface Σ needs (i) J⁻(p) ∩ Σ compact, (ii) a finite cover of it by I⁺(q_i), (iii) every x ∈ J⁺(Σ) ∩ J⁻(p) above a point of J⁻(p) ∩ Σ (past-inextensible curve through p, x; CurvesExtend + acausality of Σ), (iv) J⁺(Σ) ∩ J⁻(p) closed; then it is a closed subset of the finite union of the compact diamonds J(q_i,p). (i) and (iv) are not in the library (no limit-curve theorem; CompactCauchy has only exists_not_mem_Jminus_of_isCompact)
R1, past form, same obstruction with the time orientation reversed

findings: A4 (finding for packages 6/11): the τ_q property Sbierski uses — 'τ_q(r) is only greater than zero for r ∈ J⁻(q)' (1309.7591 p.19, pdftotext l.983), keeping S ⊆ Ū ∩ J⁺(ι(M)) — is used in the proof of Thm 3.6, not in Lemma 3.11 (p.18, which only produces q ∈ I⁺(p) with J⁻(q) ∩ Uᶜ ∩ J⁺(Σ) ⊆ W). The Level-B field B4 as approved is satisfied by the flat time ∓t on a small diamond (minkowski_slice_future/past, sorry-free) and lacks that localisation. Counterexample to using B4's N whole, 1+1 Minkowski: U = {t < −|x|/2}, Σ = {t = −1 − |x|/2}, p = 0, q = (δ,0); on K = J⁻(q) ∩ Uᶜ ∩ J⁺(Σ) the time τ = −t is maximal at t = −δ, attained at x = ±2δ on ∂U, but {t = −δ} ∩ W enters int(Uᶜ) for 2δ < |x| < ε − δ. So FromModel's A4 derivation must take U ∪ (N ∩ I⁻(q)), or B4 needs a localisation clause (gx). Not a defect of package 12: B4 as approved is proved correctly.
B3 curvesExtend holds on every flat spacetime (T2, SC) without global hyperbolicity, via the chronal causal flow (flat_curvesExtend); gx review C3's GH restriction is not needed in the flat case.
B2 localUnique_reg for the flat model uses neither injectivity nor the MapsTo hypothesis (flat_localUnique_reg): on a connected open set a local isometry is one isometry.

A3 for the flat model is not derived here (design §4 calls it trivial): a flat-specific proof of GermExtFuture/Past would use flat_localUnique_reg plus connectedness of the piece U ∩ O near p ∈ ∂U, and that φ p = q for the cluster value q; the connectedness is the owed step. With it flat_cbg would rest on R1 + A4 only (the past-side BTZ obstruction of FromModel is vacuous for sing = ∅).

kb_proposals: Level-B structures are Σ' (ChartedSpace, HasGroupoid): a lemma stated with section instances [ChartedSpace Y M] [HasGroupoid M G] does not fire on LocalModel.causality s (the HasGroupoid instance depends on s.1); first `letI := s.1; haveI : HasGroupoid M G := s.2` and `show chartedCausality … M`, then rewrite.

An IsCauchySurfaceOn W S only sees S ∩ W (isCauchySurfaceOn_congr in Flat/CBG); with isCauchySurfaceOn_graph_of_saturated (Flat/LipschitzGraph) for a constant graph, the slice t = c is Cauchy in the Minkowski diamond centred at time c — the cheap local Cauchy slice.
